name: @emsenn/llm-computer
description: The LLM domain's computing: drive a bounded agentic loop over an injected inference function, fold each turn into a settling run carrier, run tools through a governance gate, convert MCP tool catalogs into tool definitions, and project inference cost into a double-entry ledger transaction. Pure: no network, no keys, no clock it was not handed. The RUNNING of inference — sockets, API keys — is services/llm-server's job; this app only DOES the computing.

scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
